Insurance

Private Car Insurance in Kenya

Private car insurance covers a vehicle used for social, domestic and pleasure purposes. You choose between comprehensive cover for your own car and a lower level of cover that protects you mainly against claims from others.

Request a quoteSpeak to an advisor

General information only. What is covered, the terms and the premium depend on the insurer’s policy wording, your circumstances and the information you disclose. Nothing here is a promise of cover.

What it covers

  • Comprehensive: accidental damage, fire, theft and third-party liability
  • Third party only: legal liability to others, not your own car
  • Optional extensions where the insurer offers them

Who needs it

  • Individual car owners
  • Families with more than one vehicle
  • Buyers of a new or used car

Common risks

Underinsured value

Check the sum insured against the realistic market value of the car.

Important considerations and exclusions

  • Excess and exclusions apply.
  • Declared use matters.

What affects the premium

  • Vehicle value
  • Driver profile
  • Claims history
  • Cover level

Premiums are set by insurers, so we do not publish figures. Tell us about your situation and we will explain what is driving the quotation.

What we need for a quotation

  • Vehicle details and value
  • Driver details
  • Claims history

How Chestnut can help

We explain the cover in plain language, collect the information insurers need, approach suitable insurers for terms, and help with renewals and claims. Policies are issued by insurers, and you decide what to buy.

Frequently asked questions

Do I need a valuation?

Some insurers require one for older or imported vehicles. We tell you at quotation.
